title: scheduler exec: the host half, a gRPC server on a unix socket in a labelled herdr pane that runs an allowlisted verb table (herdr, the seat script, the queue script, the event writer) with a timeout and returns exit code and output tails
text: It decides nothing: a verb not in its table is refused, an argument with a newline is refused, every call is one JSON log line. It is the one place that changes when the bus lands.
